components.name: module-terraform
components.description: SWAO Terraform generation module (Consultant tier): the `generate-tf` command (Terraform modules for the matched sovereign landing zone) plus its GenerateTfScreen (ADR-0048 modular architecture, Phase 5, #0578). TF generation is not yet implemented; the command is a tier-gated stub today. The runtime gate is `requireTier('consultant', { feature: 'generate-tf' })` (ADR-0049: tier-gating is runtime requireTier; the command stays visible). The host injects its SWAO version (branding is host-only) into the screen.

components.name: module-powerbi
components.description: SWAO BI-export module (Community tier): the `export` command (CSV star schema + NDJSON + XLSX bundle for PowerBI) plus its ExportBiScreen and the bundled .pbit PowerBI templates (ADR-0048 modular architecture, Phase 5, #0577). BI export is ungated; the .pbit templates are public artefacts. The only tier gate is the runtime `requireTier('enterprise', { feature: 'export --portfolio' })` on the --portfolio flag (the portfolio data emission, not the template). The host injects its SWAO version (branding is host-only) into the screen.

components.name: module-portfolio
components.description: SWAO portfolio orchestration module (Enterprise tier): the spawn-based PortfolioOrchestrator that discovers apps under <workspace>/apps/ and dispatches a swao CLI run per app (swao assess --app <id>, report --app <id>, ...), aggregating per-app ok/fail status -- plus the PortfolioScreen TUI. ADR-0048 modular architecture, Phase 5, #0579. The general per-app dispatcher is separate from the existing --portfolio --lzr aggregate (runPortfolioLzr stays host-side, LZR-specific). The orchestrator never imports assess/report/export code (that would be module->module); it spawns the host CLI exactly like @swao/module-mcp. The swao CLI invocation is host-injected (PortfolioHostDeps { swaoCliPath, cliIsScript } + resolveSpawn, mirroring McpHostDeps): the host computes it in index.ts (pkg binary -> process.execPath; dev -> the host entry via node) and builds the production runForApp. The runtime gate stays requireTier('enterprise', ...) on the three --portfolio flags (preserved, not a new decision).

components.name: module-pdf-report
components.description: SWAO PDF report renderer module (Consultant tier): the pdfkit-backed renderer that turns a formatted text report into a branded, paginated PDF (ADR-0048 modular architecture, Phase 5, #0576). The `report` command + ReportScreen stay in the host (Community keeps text/yaml/view formats); only the PDF rendering moves here. The host injects its branding constants (SWAO version / contacts / landing URL) via the renderer params -- branding is host-only.

components.name: module-mcp
components.description: SWAO MCP module: the Model Context Protocol server (stdio + HTTP transports) and the `mcp` CLI command. Spawns the host SWAO CLI for tool calls; the host injects the CLI invocation via McpHostDeps.

components.name: module-llm-providers
components.description: SWAO LLM provider drivers (Anthropic, Ollama, OpenAI), the provider factory, the on-disk cassette cache layer, and the usage tracker. Open LLM interface: any connection string resolves to a provider.

components.name: module-llm-assessment
components.description: SWAO LLM Assessment module: compare 2..5 LLM (connector, model) legs on an assessed application (Design 092, type:llm)

components.name: module-landing-zone
components.description: SWAO landing-zone module: CSP service catalogue, customer LZ scan, and LZ fit/gap assessment (type:landing-zone, Design 056)

components.name: module-html-report
components.description: SWAO HTML publication module (Community tier): the Mode A single-page HTML renderer (the shipping feature), the `publish` CLI command, the Publish / Serve TUI screens and the Publication Editor (publish --edit, a node:http server). ADR-0048 modular architecture, Phase 4, #0575. The Consultant HTML Portal (Mode B site builder, portfolio portal, live portal server) relocated to @swao/module-html-portal (#0582 module-split stage 2). The host injects the SWAO version (branding is host-only) and the portal builder via registerPublish.

components.name: module-html-portal
components.description: SWAO HTML Portal module (Consultant tier): the multi-page portfolio portal (buildPortalSite), the Mode B per-app static-site builder (buildModeBSite) and the coming-soon live portal server (createPortalServer). Every page is assembled through the shared @swao/publication-render leaf pipeline, so style + content parity with the single-page publication is structural (ADR-0048 modular architecture, Sprint 064 #0582 module-split stage 2; Design 058 D-PORTAL-1). The Community `publish` command stays in @swao/module-html-report and reaches buildPortalSite by host injection; this module never imports the Community sibling.

components.name: module-health-check
components.description: SWAO health-check module: the health-check / health-check-pii / health-check-tags commands and the diagnostic probe registry (ProbeContribution[]). Host-coupled probes (Playwright, compliance catalogues, VCS auth, import templates, audit ingestion) are injected by the host; health-check-only probes live here.

components.name: module-framework
components.description: SWAO framework module: the framework registry and the ComplianceEvaluatorContribution service (COMP control evaluation), extracted from app-assessment pass-11 so any assessment type can reach it via the host.

components.name: module-challenge
components.description: SWAO stakeholder-challenge module (Enterprise tier): the `challenge` command (LLM agents stress-test a WSP assessment from five stakeholder personas) plus its ChallengeScreen and the persona taxonomy (PERSONAS / AGENT_IDS / CANONICAL_AGENT_ORDER / reportViewToAgentId, consumed by the host report command). ADR-0048 modular architecture, Phase 5, #0580. The runtime gate is `requireTier('enterprise', { feature: 'challenge' })` (ADR-0049: tier-gating is runtime requireTier; the command stays visible). Enterprise is the preserved current gate (migrated from premium), not a new decision. The host injects its SWAO version (branding is host-only) into the screen and the createLlmProvider factory (a sibling-module function) into registerChallenge.

components.name: module-app-assessment

components.name: community-frameworks

A leaf content package (no @swao deps) so consultant/enterprise framework packages can sit alongside it.
